pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā paribhuñjati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.3: atha kho sā bhikkhunī taṃ cīvaraṃ saṃharitvā nikkhipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.5: “yante ayye mayā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattitaṃ kahaṃ taṃ cīvara”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.6: atha kho sā bhikkhunī taṃ cīvaraṃ nīharitvā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā dassesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.8: “handayye tuyhaṃ cīvaraṃ, āhara me taṃ cīvaraṃ. yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhamevetaṃ yaṃ mayhaṃ mayhamevetaṃ. āhara metaṃ sakaṃ paccāharā”ti acchindi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.9: atha kho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.10: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.11: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindissatī”ti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.14: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.17: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.19: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.20.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā sā pacchā evaṃ vadeyya handayye tuyhaṃ cīvaraṃ, āhara me taṃ cīvaraṃ, yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhamevetaṃ yaṃ mayhaṃ mayhamevetaṃ, āhara metaṃ cīvaraṃ sakaṃ paccāharāti acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.8: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanupagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.10: parittena vā vipulaṃ vipulena vā parittaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.15: sakiṃ āṇattā bahukampi acchindati nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.16: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.19: idaṃ me ayye cīvaraṃ bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ parivattetvā acchinditaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.2: upasampannāya vematikā cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññā cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.4: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.5: anupasampannāya saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
